intro: Memphis's non-climate 10x10 street rate is $76/month, down 1.3% from a year earlier (StorageCafe, September 2026). The climate-controlled 10x10 figure on the same StorageCafe page is about $103. StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city, and Storage Stats has no market page for it, so that StorageCafe figure is the advertised rate. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe street rates); no StorageUnitCosts city page; no Storage Stats market page

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. StorageCafe street rate $31 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$37.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe street rate $44 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$58. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. City street rate $76, down 1.3% from a year earlier (StorageCafe industry statistics, Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city. Storage Stats does not publish a market page for this city. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$103.
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe street rate $98 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$143.
Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe street rate $119 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$176.

local_tips: StorageCafe lists East Memphis Park (~$72), Frayser (~$79), Fox Meadows (~$79) among the cheaper areas for a standard unit. Bal - Moral (~$205) is among the highest.
Memphis has about 96 facilities and 8.4 sq ft of storage per person (StorageCafe).
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
